rows.grounds: demonstrative pronoun referring to the principle/reality
the truth or reality to be known
vocative address to Pārvatī as mistress of the Kula

items.question: What knowledge qualifies a person to be recognized as the true guru?
premises: There is a specific principle or reality to be known.
A person may have direct knowledge of that principle.
The title of guru is attributed based on possessing that knowledge.
items.inference: Therefore, the one by whom that principle is known is the guru.
uncertainties: The specific content of 'tat tattvaṃ' is not explicitly defined in this verse and depends on context.
items.plain_english: O lady of the Kula, he by whom that principle is known is the guru.
